issues.description: Wrong page is being displayed. The current URL is /design/step-2 but the browser is showing what appears to be the step-1 room selection screen. The expected screen (step-3b) should show style blend confirmation with percentage bars (e.g. 65% Scandinavian, 35% Japandi), human-readable style names, a 'This feels right' confirm button, and slider adjustment options.
issues.root_cause: The console logs show a hydration mismatch: 'Text content did not match. Server: "%s" Client: "%s"%s Which room are we designing? Style Quiz'. The server rendered 'Which room are we designing?' but the client rendered 'Style Quiz'. This suggests the step-3 page is rendering the wrong title. Additionally, the URL is /design/step-2 but the screenshot shows room selection (step-1 content). The page:mount event for step-3b fired but then a Fast Refresh caused fallback to browser navigation to /design/step-2, showing stale/wrong content.

issues.description: Hydration error in step-3/page.tsx - server renders 'Which room are we designing?' but client renders 'Style Quiz'. The title text is mismatched between SSR and client render, causing full root hydration failure.
issues.root_cause: In apps/web/app/design/step-3/page.tsx, the component CovaStyleQuizPage is likely reading state from localStorage or a context that only exists client-side for the title, causing server to render a fallback title ('Which room are we designing?') while client renders 'Style Quiz'.

issues.description: Step-3b page (style blend confirmation) is not implemented or not navigating correctly. The page:mount event for step-3b fired but the visible screen shows room selection content.
issues.root_cause: The step-3b page either doesn't exist, redirects incorrectly, or the style blend data (percentages, human-readable style names) is not being passed/stored properly from step-3.
